task: ae.earley: Earley parser for arbitrary CFGs with ambiguity counting, tree enumeration, error reporting and oracle tests
reasoning_summary: Wrote the grammar format and tests first, including an independent brute-force oracle (derivability fixpoint, cycle detection, counting) on seeded random grammars. Implemented Earley with the nullable predictor fix and chart-derived counting/enumeration. Two test defects (duplicate-rule trees compared by toString, guessed outcome-mix floors) were fixed; a 15-mutant pass killed every mutant.
